_about: GENERATED by docs/plan/tools/skill_enchant.js — do not edit by hand. Skill enchant (H5, level 76+, 3rd class): groups (SP / adena / books / chance per +level and character level), every enchantable skill with its routes, the rules. Logic: Dashboard/skillenchant_logic.js. Plan for the bots: Scripts/data/skill_enchant_plan.json.

sources.forum: https://community.lineage2toggle.com/index.php?/topic/2753-skill-enchant-table/ (yoyoyaya 2024-12-03; 2 images, no text, no replies, 1 page)
sources.datapack: L2J H5 Shagooh/l2j-server-datapack: data/enchantSkillGroups.xml (copy: Scripts/data/dp/enchantSkillGroups.xml), data/stats/skills/*.xml (Scripts/data/dp/skills), data/skillTrees/classSkillTree.xml, multisell/, buylists/
sources.server: L2J Shagooh/l2j-server-game: RequestExEnchantSkill D0:0F, RequestExEnchantSkillSafe D0:32, RequestExEnchantSkillUntrain D0:33, RequestExEnchantSkillRouteChange D0:34, RequestExEnchantSkillInfoDetail D0:31 (all: skillId, skillLevel as int32); L2EnchantSkillGroup.getRate; config general.properties + character.properties
sources.client: L2Swarm Data/base.db entry "Skills" (route names ENCH_DESCR, per-level text ENCH_WITH_DESCR)

tags.rules: SERVER (L2J code; L2Toggle not verified live)

rules.requirement: 3rd class (class tier 3) and character level >= 76; not while attacking, transformed or on a boat (isAllowedToEnchantSkills). No NPC is needed in the L2J code (the client opens the enchant window from the skill list); L2Toggle not verified.
rules.startLevel: +1 of a route needs the skill at its MAX base level (getMinSkillLevel: x01 -> base max level, else level - 1). Skill level on the wire = route * 100 + plus (101 = route 1 +1).
rules.chance: column of the CHARACTER level 76..85 (level - 76); below 76 = 0. Roll: Rnd.get(100) <= rate, i.e. really (rate + 1) %; the logic uses rate % (a little conservative).
rules.normal: Giant's Codex (6622) only for the first enchant of a route (+1) — EnchantSkillSpBookNeeded=True. Fail = the skill drops to its BASE level (all + lost; every SP / adena spent is gone).
rules.safe: Giant's Codex - Mastery (9627) for EVERY attempt, SP and adena x5 (SafeEnchantCostMultipiler). Fail = level stays.
rules.untrain: Giant's Codex - Oblivion (9625): pays the adena of the current level, gives back 80 % of its SP, -1 level.
rules.routeChange: Giant's Codex - Discipline (9626): pays SP + adena of that level, keeps +N on the new route then loses Rnd.get(min(4, N)) levels (0-3).

forumVsDatapack.note: Every shaded forum cell equals the DATAPACK except 2nd +24 @ 85 (forum 51, datapack 46; the forum fits the -2 pattern 55/53/51, so the datapack value looks like a typo). The logic uses the DATAPACK value (the lower one). White cells (6/2/1 %) do NOT match the datapack and are probably the author's "not worth it" marker (INFERRED). +1 @ 81 is empty in the 2nd image (datapack 97: image glitch).
